decisions.reason: As a newly launched drainage component with its own page and a close fit to the firm's core engineering and installation offer, it likely remains above a minimum aspiration and worth carrying while market acceptance becomes clearer.

A floor-level shower drainage system fits the firm's strategic direction toward integrated and accessible shower solutions, so management would likely retain it absent clear evidence of underperformance.
Its dedicated presentation and strong match with the firm's design-conscious bathroom positioning make it likely to meet aspirations well enough to avoid problemistic search.

An integrated-slope shower element supports installation ease and renovation use cases central to the firm's trajectory, so an established firm with some slack would likely keep it after only one year.
The product was explicitly introduced as a solution to a concrete customer problem and given its own page, suggesting commitment and satisfactory promise relative to aspiration levels.

Although it is more peripheral to the firm's shower-drainage focus and received only limited website prominence, it still complements the drainage portfolio and would more likely be kept than dropped this early.
